claim: Is 'floof' a real word? : r/EnglishLearning - Reddit
summary: floof is a real word used in informal speech and writing. it often refers as a noun to the fluffy fur of an animal, which I wouldn't describe as fluff. But floofy is just fluffy pronounced and spelled differently floof the noun can also describe the animal that the fur is on. "My baby Roxy is a big ball of floof"
